questions.question: Should the visible pie-sector boundaries and relative areas be recorded as a cross-check that the Apple-labeled sector is larger than the Xiaomi-, Samsung-, and Others-labeled sectors, rather than relying only on the printed percentage inscriptions?

Does any supplied public task context establish that the displayed dashboard values refer to a current reporting period, or does the absent date/current-period inscription leave that condition dependent on the task instruction alone?

summary: Inspected the chart title, all four slice inscriptions, their visible attachment to sectors, and the absence of a visible date or current-period label. The existing set covers the printed-value leader reading, Europe scope, action rule, and temporal limitation; remaining checks concern geometric corroboration and the source of the required current-period qualification.
